description.name: Conditional Attach Element From Party
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire]/[Attach Ice]/[Attach Lightning]/[Attach Earth]/[Attach Wind]/[Attach Water]/[Attach Holy]/[Attach Dark]/[Attach Poison] if current number of combined Attach Element statuses on party members are a majority Attach Fire/Ice/Lightning/Earth/Wind/Water/Holy/Dark/Poison. In the case of ties the prior listed order is used to determine status granted

description.name: Prismatic +50% Boost
description.text: Fire, Ice, Lightning, Earth, Wind, Water, Holy, Dark and Poison attacks deal 50% more damage

description.name: Striking Reminiscence Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Striking Reminiscence after using two abilities

description.name: Our Fantasy Unbound Ability Tracker
description.text: Increases Our Fantasy Unbound level by 1 after using 6 or 10 abilities during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Tyro]

description.name: Our Fantasy Unbound Level
description.text: Keeps track of Our Fantasy Unbound level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Tyro]

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Tyro
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Our Fantasy Unbound (0~2), removed after using Our Fantasy Unbound two times
